q: Break that down by product and channel.

answer:
This week’s shortfall in sales is concentrated in a few paid channels and your biggest SKUs — paid social (IG) and Google PMax fell, while exchange_removal and unattributed rose, and your top boot SKUs saw large revenue drops.

- Channels (Oct 12–14 vs Oct 9–11)
  - ig_feed: ₹63,605 this week vs ₹76,230 prior.
  - google_pmax: ₹15,995 vs ₹22,316.
  - google_search: ₹31,190 vs ₹16,581 (increase).
  - exchange_replacement: ₹38,625 vs ₹35,494 (increase).
  - unattributed: ₹24,222 vs ₹8,294 (increase).
  - fb_feed: ₹12,625 vs ₹12,811 (roughly flat).

- Products (top movers, product net revenue; Oct 12–14 vs Oct 9–11)
  - Play Scratch Lounge: ₹18,553 (current week top seller).
  - Pawveralls Suspender Boots: ₹16,731 vs ₹35,579 (large drop).
  - Pawveralls Pro Suspender Boots: ₹15,037 vs ₹20,543 (drop).
  - WildTrail Boots: ₹12,705 vs ₹1,525 (jump in week-to-week mix for WildTrail).
  - SnugSole Boots: ₹11,520 vs ₹17,957 (decline).

What this means
- The overall sales decline is driven by fewer orders from high-value boot SKUs (Pawveralls family and SnugSole) and reduced revenue from ig_feed and google_pmax; partial offsets came from google_search, exchange_replacement and unattributed orders.
- Channel mix shifted toward unattributed and exchange_replacement this week, suggesting either tracking/attribution changes or more organic/direct activity while paid spend dropped (earlier comparison showed ad spend fell with volume).

Worth checking: ad spend and campaign changes on IG and Google PMax over Oct 9–14, and whether any attribution/tracking changes or promotions affected Pawveralls listings.
